findings.evidence: scripts/rollout_project.py:417-422 strips quotes before comparing to DEFAULT_RUNNER, so quoted values return "default". The rendered baseline has the unquoted form. The file is still a hand edit on the `runs-on` line that the new render changes next to. That is the same Copier replay conflict the change exists to avoid. The test test_rollout_treats_a_quoted_default_runner_as_the_default (tests/test_ci_runner_selection.py) stops after the preflight and never runs `copier update` or the doctor. I could not confirm that the update then conflicts or that the doctor fails.
findings.summary: A quoted `"ubuntu-latest"` or `'ubuntu-latest'` runner is classified as `default`. The rollout then takes the ordinary `copier update` path, with no revert and no baseline proof.

findings.evidence: scripts/rollout_project.py:464-473 writes the restored workflows and the answers, then runs `git add`, `git commit` and `ensure_clean`, with no rollback on error. The branch is ephemeral and the error is raised loudly, so this affects only the cleanliness of what the rollout leaves behind.
findings.summary: The migration rewrites the workflow files and `.copier-answers.yml` before it stages and commits them. A failure in `git add`, `git commit` or `ensure_clean` leaves the working tree dirty and partly migrated.
